lineage.relation: downstream evaluation phase on run_002's Boltz2 models: independent interface-affinity and PAE-based interface scoring, filling the gap left by the unavailable Antigen_Antibody_binding property

task_requirements.objective: Quantify interface quality of run_002's 6 Boltz2 models (5 candidates + H965 control) with Prodigy (predicted binding affinity, KD) and ipSAE (interface PAE score) under Boltzmann tooling
constraints: Models and PAE files come from run_002's completed Boltz2 jobs — no re-prediction
Prodigy per-model jobs because ZIP uploads break receipt validation (recorded)
metrics: comparison vs H965 control under identical tools

input_inventory.input: 12 Boltz2 model PDBs (6 jobs x 2 pairs)

stages.purpose: Prodigy binding-affinity prediction on each of the 12 PD1:VH / PD1:VL models
stages.acceptance_criteria: 12 terminal jobs; KD/logKA parsed per model

tool_calls.actual_identifier: 12 boltzmann jobs: 6af886a89de6b44b075d8685 (cand2 VH), 6af886c89850a93adf67d73b (H965 VH), 6af886d2239a6b9f38bec324 (H965 VL), 6af886df9850a93adf67d773 (cand1 VH), 6af886ea9de6b44b075d86f1 (cand1 VL), 6af886f4239a6b9f38bec38d (cand2 VL), 6af886ff9de6b44b075d872a (cand3 VH), 6af887099de6b44b075d8750 (cand3 VL), 6af88713239a6b9f38bec3dd (cand4 VH), 6af8871d239a6b9f38bec3fb (cand4 VL), 6af887289de6b44b075d8791 (cand5 VH), 6af887329850a93adf67d827 (cand5 VL)
tool_calls.selection_reason: Boltzmann-native affinity predictor; fills Antigen_Antibody_binding gap

parameter_descriptions.chain_list: interacting chains A (PD-1) and B (VH or VL)

fallback.observed_error: Structure inventory exceeds 256 KiB receipt budget -> submit-time 'validation rules changed' rejection; single-PDB submit without chain_list hit connector serialization bug (chain_list:'' -> backend 422)
fallback.recovery: per-model uploads with experiment_data {chain_list:[A,B]} declared at upload time
fallback.reason_for_switch: only route that passed receipt validation
fallback.protocol_differences: 12 jobs instead of 1-2 ZIP jobs; identical science
